metadata.title: Kharthong Kitchen : Roohi's Biate Recipe Adventure
metadata.description: Biate, an indigenous community inhabiting the North Eastern regions of India, preserves their rich culinary heritage in the quaint village of Mualdam, nestled within the Dima Hasao district of Assam. In this episode, I embark on a culinary journey alongside the kitchen host, delving into the heart of Biate cuisine to prepare 'Kharthong An'. This traditional chicken dish showcases the essence of the region, featuring a distinctive leaf known as 'Kharthong', a botanical treasure exclusive to Mualdam. Interestingly, locals believe that the leaf and the village share a unique bond, as both are aptly christened 'Kharthong'. The recipe offers a delightful blend of flavors, with the Kharthong leaf imparting a subtle hint of bitterness, culminating in a truly wholesome dining experience.
